lesson.title: Introduction to Internet Culture
lesson.overview: This lesson will introduce students to the concept of internet culture, its components, and its significance in contemporary society. We'll explore what internet culture encompasses, its origins, and how it influences daily life in the digital age.

content.definition: Internet culture refers to the culture that has emerged from the ways people communicate, create, and interact online. It includes memes, social media norms, online communities, and the impact of digital interactions on society.

components.name: Memes
components.description: Memes serve as a form of expression and humor that often encapsulate cultural references and inside jokes that resonate with online communities.

components.name: Social Media
components.description: Platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and TikTok foster connections and digital interactions that shape societal norms and behaviors.

components.name: Online Communities
components.description: Various forums, subreddits, and gaming communities form around shared interests, creating subcultures with their own rules and rituals.

history: The rise of the first online forums in the early 1990s.
The advent of social media platforms in the early 2000s.
The explosion of meme culture in the late 2000s through platforms like 4chan and Reddit.
content.impact: Internet culture shapes how individuals identify personally and socially, alters communication styles, and influences politics and global movements.

quizzes.question: What is a key component of internet culture that involves humor and shared references?

flashcards.definition: The shared practices, norms, and phenomena that arise within online spaces.
A piece of media, often humorous in nature, that spreads rapidly online and is replicated or modified by users.

takeaways: Internet culture is a multifaceted and rapidly evolving phenomenon.
Memes and social media significantly influence modern communication and societal norms.
Understanding internet culture is crucial for navigating online interactions and community dynamics.
